case_title.reason: Matches the judgment header: Alamelu & Anr. v. State represented by Inspector of Police.

number_of_accused.reason: Charge-sheet names A-1 and accused Nos. 2 to 8, i.e. eight accused, all decided by the Court.

accused_gender.quote: Alamelu (A5) were already inside the car
accused_gender.reason: Judgment does not explicitly state the gender of all accused; 'Mixed' rests on names, not stated facts.

accused_age.reason: No age of any accused is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of the accused is stated; only that A-1 is a local boy.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the accused's wealth or class appears in the judgment.

previous_criminal_record.reason: The judgment does not mention any previous criminal record.

victim_gender.reason: The victim (PW-2) is female throughout the judgment.

victim_age.correct_value: Not established; prosecution/father claimed 15 years 2 months on 31 July 1993
victim_age.quote: the girl was only 15 years and 2 months old on 31st July, 1993
victim_age.reason: Judgment records the claimed age from father's account, though the Court found minority unproven; 'Not stated' omits this.

victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victim is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victim is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: No prior relationship/familiarity (A-1 not related, not on visiting terms); defence alleged old enmity over land dispute
accused_victim_relationship.quote: There is no previous history of any relationship between Sekar and the girl.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: 'Acquaintance/neighbour' overstates the link; the court found no familiarity and omits the alleged enmity.

offence_category.reason: Rape (s.376) is the principal offence alongside abduction, consistent with the charges.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC ss.366 and 376; ss.366 and 376 read with s.109 for accused Nos. 2 to 8
statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 366 and 376 read with Section 109 IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: Sections are correct, but the parenthetical gloss on s.366 is not in the judgment.

weapon.reason: No weapon is mentioned; only a car and a mangalsutra are referred to.

evidence_type.reason: Lists oral, medical/radiological, documentary and recovery evidence, all referred to in the judgment.

confession.reason: Accused's statement to police that they were married is noted but not treated as a relied-upon confession.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: The judgment notes no aggravating circumstances.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: The judgment notes no mitigating circumstances.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted under ss.366/376 (with s.109 for some), ten years RI and Rs.500 fine, default three months.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court dismissed the appeals, confirming the common judgment of conviction and sentence.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court allowed the appeals and acquitted all appellants.

offence_finally_established.reason: All appellants were acquitted, so no offence is finally established.

imprisonment_type.reason: Acquittal means no final sentence; 'none' is appropriate.

imprisonment_years.reason: No final fixed-term sentence exists after acquittal.

fine_rs.reason: No final fine exists after acquittal.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Sugavanam, who received the call, is not described as a relative; the call was received by a person not identified as kin
neutral_facts.quote: This incident was informed to the father (PW1) of the victim by one Sugavanam, who had received a call from Sekar (A1).
neutral_facts.reason: Summary wrongly calls the call-recipient a relative; other facts are accurate and neutral with no outcome revealed.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory punishment range for the offences.

attempt_completion.reason: The prosecution alleged completed abduction and rape; the value reflects that allegation.

physical_harm.reason: Judgment records alleged repeated rape and no injury findings; the value reflects this.

number_of_offences.reason: Two sections charged (366 and 376), with none finally upheld after acquittal.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is involved in the case.

premeditation_planning.reason: Court found no established planning; it held the abduction story appeared concocted.

motive.reason: Alleged motive is A-1's wish to marry the victim, which the Court found unexplained and not established.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Father's panchayat admission that daughter agreed to return; cousin's evidence of relatives at temple; father's contradictory evidence; PW5's evidence of her stay with A-1
key_evidence_accepted.quote: in his anxiety to deny that his daughter had agreed to go back home on asking of MLA, he made a very relevant disclosure
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Lists the transfer certificate and radiological evidence as accepted, though the Court rejected them; omits PW5's evidence.

witness_credibility.reason: Accurately reflects the Court's findings on the victim, father, relatives and expert age evidence.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Accurately reflects the alleged police visit, cohabitation, and the Court's view that her conduct was unnatural.

custody_duration.reason: Judgment does not state the duration of custody; only remand and release are mentioned.

bail_history.reason: The judgment contains no bail information.

trial_duration.reason: Dates for trial judgment, High Court and Supreme Court match the judgment; offence date is as alleged.

legal_representation.reason: Names of appellants' counsel and State counsel match the judgment.

investigation_status.reason: Complaint, FIR receipt, arrest, recovery and charge-sheet dates match the judgment.

procedural_irregularity.reason: Late marking of transfer certificate, Headmaster not examined, no temple witness, and ignored expert evidence are all noted.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court affirmance, and Supreme Court acquittal match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.reason: Consistency of prosecution version, Article 136 limits, and father's 15y2m age claim are all in the judgment.

defence_argument.reason: Perversity, contradictions, voluntary departure and enmity-based complaint are all argued by the defence.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Article 136 scope, benefit of doubt, proof of transfer certificate, and sole-testimony test are all applied.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: All five cases and citations match those relied on in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentence is imposed after acquittal, so 'Not applicable' is correct.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The court weighed no mitigating factors in sentencing.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The court weighed no aggravating factors in sentencing.

other_sentence_order.reason: Judgment directs that all appellants be released forthwith.
